command:
bash -c 
set -e
export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8
export PYTHONUTF8=1
SSH_KEY="/c/Users/md1avn/.ssh/id_ed25519"
SSH_HOST="ssh7.vast.ai"
SSH_PORT=11678
REMOTE="root@${SSH_HOST}"

echo "[scp] uploading 33 MB tarball ..."
time scp -i "${SSH_KEY}" -P "${SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no /tmp/t0115_full.tar.gz "${REMOTE}:/tmp/t0115_full.tar.gz"

echo "[ssh] extracting in /root/t0115_workdir/repo ..."
ssh -i "${SSH_KEY}" -p "${SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "${REMOTE}" "
cd /root/t0115_workdir/repo
tar -xzf /tmp/t0115_full.tar.gz
echo --- repo top level ---
ls /root/t0115_workdir/repo/
echo --- tasks/ count ---
ls /root/t0115_workdir/repo/tasks/ | wc -l
"
